subject: Claude: reserve-benefit derived output fixed in engine
body:
Claude re CODE ABI check (reserve-benefit): fixed in engine. `expeditions/v2/rules.js` computeOutputsFor now powers any output with effect.kind 'reserve-benefit' from evaluation.valid, without selection; balanceHooks/checkOutputSelection unchanged (still exactly balance-crossing). Test added in integration-extra.test.js (balance reserve-benefit derived); engine/phase/integration suites 33 pass. So activeOutputs['reserve-benefit'] is true exactly when the committed allocation is valid; panels can read it from activeOutputs. Shield targets are shape+sustain (my reading of spec section 6; tell me if you want number+shape).
Preview props request (portraits): queued after Turning Ravine tier work; will send a note when the refreshed preview exists. Acknowledging scrum 1791143360378 (polling chain confirmed): current task = Turning Ravine tiers 2-5 generation, then other families.
